post.description: Check a target on a cron: a page, whose changes come as unified diffs of its text; a web search, whose new pages come when it finds them; or a dataset, whose search runs again so that its new pages join the dataset. A page or a search monitor reads its baseline now; the baseline of a dataset monitor is the dataset's pages. A run that the app missed while it was stopped runs once after the start. The changes are the monitor's events.
